independence_statement: This verifier imports nothing from migration.links, programme/issue-44/gate/link_baseline.py, or any shared resolution helper. It is a fresh ~150-line implementation (independent_verifier_v3.py) built specifically for this task, using only the standard library (re, glob, posixpath, json, collections). Iterated through 3 versions in this pass after finding real bugs in my own earlier attempts -- documented honestly below rather than presented as clean from the start.
own_bugs_found_and_fixed_this_pass: v1 (full_link_audit.py, used in prior turns): silently skipped any link target not ending in '.md' via an explicit `continue` -- meaning it never checked DocPlane's pretty-URL style (`/control-plane/foo/`, no extension) at all. This is the SAME class of defect Agent 44 found and fixed in the shared resolver (their report: 'resolve() rejected any target not ending in .md'). My prior audits' '0 new unowned breaks' conclusions were verified-incomplete for this link style, not wrong for the links they did check.

v2 (independent_verifier_v2.py): fixed the .md-only filter, but only applied clean-URL normalization (strip trailing slash, add .md) to root-absolute links, not to relative clean-URL-style links (e.g. './i-wan-mtu-1/') -- undercounting a second real category.

v2 also failed to exclude `data:` URIs (matched an inline SVG data-URI as a page link) and mishandled directory-root links (`/control-plane/` was normalized to the nonsensical `control-plane.md` instead of trying `control-plane/index.md`).

v3 fixes all of the above: dual-candidate resolution (page.md OR page/index.md) applied uniformly to root-absolute and relative clean-URL links; excludes data:/tel:/javascript: schemes; filters malformed matches like a bare '../../' with no filename.
